Author: Pamidighantam Sri Narasimha
Bench: Pamidighantam Sri Narasimha

 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction

 (@ Out of SLP(Crl.) No.6527/2025)
 Rahul Kumar Harinath Pal Appellant
 Versus
 State Of Maharashtra Responden
ORDER 1.
Leave granted.

2. This appeal is against the order of the High Court of Judicature at Bombay dated 15-04-2025 by which the appellants Anticipatory Bail Application No.967/2025 arising out of a crime No.0099/2025 registered at Police Station Bhoiwada, Thane City under Sections 123, 223, 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e), 3(1)(zz)(iv)
and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 has been dismissed.

entities.text: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. The allegation against the appellant is that on a secret information about a person illegally selling prohibited articles like Gutka and Pan Masala by making huge stock at Balaji Nagar Bhiwandi, the police conducted a raid and found the seized articles worth Rs. 2,36,700/-.
The application for anticipatory bail filed by the appellant was rejected by the Trial Court as well as by the High Court on 27.03.2025 and 15.04.2025 respectively.
4. While issuing notice in the Special Leave Petition, this Court passed an order on 01.05.2025 granting interim protection to the appellant.

entities.text: Rahul Kumar Harinath Pal vs State Of Maharashtra on 18 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Shrirang B. Varma, Standing Counsel for the State of Maharashtra.
6. Having considered the matter in detail we are of the opinion that the appellant should be given the benefit of anticipatory bail.

7. In this view of the matter, we confirm our order dated 01.05.2025 and direct that in the event the appellant is arrested, he shall be released on bail subject to such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the Trial Court.
8. Needless to say, that the appellant shall fully cooperate with the investigation.
In case the appellant does not cooperate in the investigation, State is at liberty to move the Trial Court for cancellation of his anticipatory bail.
9. The appeal is allowed accordingly.
..J. [PAMIDIGHANTAM SRI NARASIMHA] ..J.
[ATUL S.
CHANDURKAR] New Delhi 18-07-2025
